title: mallard install verify --format json
description: The verdict of mallard install verify: the environment check and the quick run of each solver installed. Minor versions add fields; readers ignore fields they do not know.

mallard.description: The version of this build, as mallard --version prints it.

prefix.description: The install's prefix: the directory of bin/.

launcher.description: The --launcher the checks ran under; empty for none.

directory.description: With --keep: where the checks' cases and logs are.

detail.description: What was found, or why the check failed.

backend.description: environment: the Kokkos backend of the build.

monitors.description: run: the monitors of the last progress record, compared with the exact solution.
